company.name: The Grace Hopper Program at Fullstack Academy

positions.title: Ophthalmic Technician
positions.description:
Managed 20 to 40 patient visits per work day
Reviewed patient’s history and performed appropriate eye scans, testings, vision tests, and refractions for the visit
Checked intraocular pressure with Goldmann applanation tonometry
Took patient’s history for status of vision and any ocular illnesses or concerns
Taught patients proper contact lens insertion, removal, and care
Assisted with corneal cross-linking procedures
positions.insights: Skills: Eye Exams · ocular imaging · intraocular pressure check goldmann · refractions

positions.title: Procedural Technician
positions.description:
Aided with 30 to 50 procedures per work day
Prepared procedure rooms for colonoscopies and endoscopies and aided biopsies and snares for specimen collection
Scribed for every procedure of the day, which included writing reports as per doctors’ instructions, taking pictures of vital areas, prescribing medications per doctor’s orders, and completing take-home reports for patients
Trained 6 new employees for surgical technician and scribe positions

positions.title: Office Assitant
positions.description:
Filed documents, took phone calls, and assisted students creating dormitory work orders
Escorted outside contractors and workers into students’ rooms for work orders
Assisted housing directors with projects for the dormitories
